daily_summary.html:
Domestic Politics

Minister of Law and Human Rights Yusril Ihza Mahendra denied ordering the freezing of a Pati activist's bank account, following controversy over Bank Mandiri's earlier action against an account linked to protest donations. Yusril separately pledged the government would complete the Asset Forfeiture Bill in 2026. The account in question has since been unfrozen by Bank Mandiri.

  • Communications and Digital Affairs Minister called on citizens not to spread hate speech ahead of planned demonstrations at the DPR on 27 August, while Jakarta police urged protesters not to damage public facilities during the rallies.
  • Four groups will demonstrate on 27 August in Jakarta, including residents from Pati, Bangkalan, Depok, and students bringing demands on MBG, taxes, labour wages, and corruption issues.
  • Gaspol party leader Budi Arie clarified issues about election acceleration and denied treason allegations in a public statement.
  • A DPR member encouraged Bengkulu residents to support the 2026 National Economic Census.
  • Political analyst Denny Indrayana urged caution regarding tomorrow's demonstrations, calling for careful conduct during the planned protests.
  • A pre-trial hearing decision on Febrie Adriansyah's case against the Police is scheduled for today at South Jakarta District Court, with his lawyers claiming his rights have been violated.

Foreign Policy & Defence

The Russian ambassador deferred to Indonesian authorities over the handling of a Russian citizen detained in Wamena, Papua, stating that Russia would respect Indonesia's legal processes in the matter. The case involves a Russian national currently being held by Indonesian law enforcement in the remote highland town.

  • Australian Foreign Minister Penny Wong said the Jakarta Treaty 2026 was developed for future generations, while Australia's Defence Minister pushed for operational implementation of the treaty framework.
  • DPR member Connie Bakrie stated the prospective aircraft carrier Giuseppe Garibaldi would not be a "game changer" for the Indonesian Navy's strength, commenting on the planned acquisition.
  • The proposed aircraft carrier Giuseppe Garibaldi will be renamed KRI Gajah Mada with a new base planned for Lampung, according to reports on Indonesia's first aircraft carrier.

Other

The Corruption Eradication Commission (KPK) seized Rp 2.8 billion in cash related to a customs import case, with investigators revealing that the head of Kediri Customs, Gatot Heroe, received Rp 3.25 billion from Blueray company's owner. The KPK also disclosed that a customs official offered to arrange a meeting between the Blueray boss and customs director-general Djaka Budhi Utama.

  • President Prabowo ordered BRIN to develop desalination technology for remote areas, while also instructing the establishment of tree seed centres for reforestation and water security.
  • Indonesia's oil output remains 5 percent below the 2026 target, according to the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources.
  • The government treated public complaints about decile changes as corrections to its social assistance targeting system.
  • Indonesia deployed 4.6 million litres of water to combat ongoing wildfires, while the Environment and Forestry Minister said rain is the most effective way to extinguish forest fires and urged weather modification efforts.
  • The Prosecutors' Office in Purwakarta detained three suspects in a state bank KUR corruption case that caused Rp 3.4 billion in state losses.
